title.zh: 货币（硬币面额与特征）公告 2024
title.en: Currency (Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) Notification 2024

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Currency Act 1967
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins)
Notification 2024
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act 1967, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 1 January 2025 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2025 CHINESE ALMANAC COINS
(YEAR OF THE SNAKE) TO BE ISSUED ON 1 JANUARY 2025
Part 1
Denomination
$2
Metal
999 Fine Silver
Nickel-plated 99% Zinc
Standard Weight
7.776 g + 0.15 g
20.000 g + 1.70 g
Standard Diameter
27.00 mm ± 0.30 mm
40.70 mm ± 0.40 mm
Standard Thickness
1.90 mm ± 0.40 mm
2.90 mm ± 0.40 mm
Shape
Round
Edge
Milled
Design of Obverse
1.The background of the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin and the $2 nickel‑plated zinc proof‑like coin is shiny silver.
2.The Singapore Coat of Arms is engraved in the centre of the coin with the year‑date “2025” below it.
3.The word “SINGAPORE” appears once in each of the 4 official languages and is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms.
Design of Reverse
1.The background of the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin and the $2 nickel-plated zinc proof‑like coin is shiny silver.
2.The $2 silver proof‑like colour coin and the $2 nickel‑plated zinc proof‑like coin share a common design which features —
(a)a snake in the centre of the foreground;
(b)the Henderson Waves of the Southern Ridges in the background, stretching from the left side to the right side of the coin, partially covered by the snake’s body and tail;
(c)trees in the background, on each of the left and right sides of the coin; and
(d)the denomination “$2” engraved and placed at 10 o’clock, to the left of the snake.
3.The weight in troy oz and fineness of the coin are engraved above the snake of the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin.
4.The snake featured in the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin is in colour.

Design of Obverse
1.The background of the $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin is shiny silver.
2.The background of the $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin is shiny gold.
3.The Singapore Coat of Arms is engraved in the centre of the coin with the year‑date “2025” below it.
4.The word “SINGAPORE” appears once in each of the 4 official languages and is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms.
5.The mintmark is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms at 5 o’clock for the $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin.
Design of Reverse
1.The background of the $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin is shiny silver.
2.The background of the $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin is shiny gold.
3.The $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin share a common design which features —
(a)a snake in the centre of the foreground;
(b)the Henderson Waves of the Southern Ridges in the background, stretching from the left side to the right side of the coin, partially covered by the snake’s body and tail;
(c)trees in the background, on each of the left and right sides of the coin;
(d)the denomination “$5” engraved and placed at 10 o’clock, to the left of the snake; and
(e)the weight in troy oz and fineness of the coin, engraved above the snake.
4.The snake featured in the $5 silver proof colour coin is in colour.
5.The $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin features —
(a)a snake engraved in the centre;
(b)the denomination “$5” engraved and placed at 6 o’clock, below the snake; and
(c)the weight in grams and fineness of the coin, engraved above the snake.
